known_limitations: Clouds/shadows are not masked in this dataset.
LST is not available upstream; 6 channels used, not 7.
Pixels were randomly subsampled (8,000 of the available valid pixels).

Stage 4 on synthetic data found Kernel PCA did not recover one of two true latent variables at all (not just rotated, as with Isomap/SMACOF) - worth checking whether the real-data embedding similarly concentrates on one dominant mode.
